model.jaffle_shop.exposed_view.why: exposures read it (products_dashboard): it stays a view for them, and its 1 moving readers read a table of it

model.jaffle_shop.heavy_view.why: its plan holds memory (a join, aggregate, sort or window): built once as a table

model.jaffle_shop.shared_view.why: 2 models read it: built once as a table, read by each

model.jaffle_shop.stg_locations.why: only one model reads it and its plan only streams: inlined there, nothing to store or build

model.jaffle_shop.stuck_view.why: it can't move (syntax:semi_structured, materialization:view); a table of it built on Snowflake lets 1 of its readers move, and the view stays
